The document describes cuDNN's **declarative graph API** (introduced in cuDNN 8.0), where fusion is achieved by describing computation as a *dataflow graph of operations on tensors* that is compiled into a GPU kernel (or small set of kernels) at runtime. Note: the document covers the **cuDNN operation graph**, not CUDA Graphs (cudaGraph) — the terms "cudaGraph" and "execution plan" do not appear in this page. The closest equivalents are the **"finalized graph"**, **engine**, and **engine configuration** concepts described below.
